save.text: Sam announced he's voice directing a DreamWorks cartoon 'Home'—show revealed and releases in a week (Sam, turn 63).
Cast will be guests at Tekko in Pittsburgh on the 8th–10th; Matt & Marisha mentioned panels/signings (Matt, turn 20).
Gilmore's Glorious Goods shirt pre-order deadline confusion: deadline stated as 'tomorrow at midnight' (Travis, turn 31); cast advised to order 'tonight' to be safe (Matt, turns 40, 42, 44).
Marisha's last episode as host of Signal Boost is this Tuesday; she rotates hosts but will continue producing it (Marisha, turn 76–87).
Sam asked to host Signal Boost and joked he'd likely be ~20 minutes late; Marisha agreed to make that work (Sam/Marisha, turns 88–91).
In-game: Vox Machina sealed the Gate at the Cindergrove; party is setting up camp among Pyrah tribe rebuilding huts made of fused stone/glass after Thordak's attack (Matt, turns 97–111).
Scanlan casts Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion, creates an extradimensional mansion used to offer shelter to Pyrah tribe and party (Sam/Matt, turns 139–152, 160–166, 186–192).
About 35 Pyrah/Zephrah present; Scanlan offered lodging to all refugees but they hesitated and continued building shelters (Matt/Sam, turns 165, 181, 185–187).
Scanlan's mansion has ethereal attendants (butler/maid); Travis attacked them with Craven Edge causing their energy to disperse and belongings to drop (Matt/Travis/Sam, turns 189–199).

Scanlan demonstrates maid/servant spirits are 'slave ghosts' who enjoy service; he can command ~100 servants, 50 for him and rest available to party; they perform tasks (braiding chest hair, serving food/ale) and can manifest solid goods temporarily (turns 200–259).

Marisha attempted to bring Ashari/refugees; servants' food offerings dissipated to smoke when she exited room, but she still invited refugees to take a night off and get food (Marisha/Matt, turns 265–267).
Scanlan reserved rooms upstairs: his is largest at end of hall; rooms adjacent reserved for Pike and Kaylie (turns 268–276).
Scanlan's Magnificent Mansion doorway is invitation-only (Sam confirmed, turn 281).
Mansion casting: once per day; casting takes about a minute, so can't be used mid-battle effectively (Sam/Matt/Marisha, turns 284–291).
Mansion has basement training/workspace suitable for Trinket and physical training; Laura and Travis plan to use it (Sam/Laura/Travis, turns 309–316, 352–357).
Mansion basement contains sand pit, training dummies, chains, weapon/armor racks; Trinket trained there with Grog (Matt, turn 360–385, 400–405, 434).
Trinket's attack bonus is +8 and one ram did 7 bludgeoning damage vs Grog; Grog held and knocked Trinket prone then succeeded Strength save (Matt/Laura/Travis, turns 386–396).
Laura retrieved a broom from her Bag of Holding and attempted to 'animate/ride' it unsuccessfully; then returned broom to Bag; servants expected to clean (Laura/Travis/Matt, turns 366–376, 400–428).
Sam offered to make Vex fly using his magic items; examined Gern's broom and found hidden Draconic rune meaning 'candle', which activates the broom (Sam/Matt/Laura, turns 483–525).
Laura successfully activated Gern's enchanted broom by discovering the Draconic command word and briefly flew, then hugged Scanlan (Laura/Sam/Matt, turns 521–525).

Sam offered to make Vex fly using his magic items; examined Gern's broom and found hidden Draconic rune meaning 'candle', which activates the broom; Laura successfully activated it and practiced flight (Sam/Laura/Matt, turns 483–525, 542–555).

Laura sat side-saddle on broom, flew up to ~50ft ceilings in Scanlan's mansion, made a Dex check (rolled 20) and later drifted out through doorway; group relaxed for evening afterward (Laura/Sam/Matt, turns 532–572, 575–587).
Cerkonos visits Keyleth at night; his previously burned-off arm is shown regenerating slowly; he requests to sit and speak (Matt/Marisha, turns 593–601).

Cerkonos recounted a Pyrah trainee named Raishan who opened the Gate and may be the green dragon responsible for the attack on Emon; she arrived ~age 15 and is now ~19–20 (Cerkonos/Marisha, turn 603–621, 629–631).

Keyleth (Marisha) and party recognized the name Raishan as the green dragon involved in the Conclave's assault on Emon; Marisha will watch for references to that name (Marisha/Matt, turns 626–631, 620).
Vax experienced a Raven Queen vision/dream presenting choices (rebirth/ruin, maker/martyr, conqueror/tyrant/nothing) and a snapped thread from the tapestry (Matt, turn 636).
Vex (Laura) stole a flying broom from a necromancer (Laura, turns 682–690, 708–710).
Scanlan's mansion persists long enough for Trinket to be present and interact at breakfast (Sam/Matt, turns 664–675).
Group recovered hit points/spells after rest in mansion; some had unsettling dreams/visions (Matt, turns 644–646, 636).

Vex (Laura) successfully flew on the stolen broom, fired arrows with mixed success (first hit turkey, second misfire); practiced and plans Percy-made seat/engineering help (Laura/Marisha/Taliesin, turns 715–753, 757–796, 803).
Trinket present at breakfast earlier confirmed by mansion persistence; current scene shows Vex flying in breakfast room while others present (Sam/Matt/Laura, turns 664–716, 803).

Raishan infiltrated Fire Ashari ~4 years ago posing as a ~15-year-old human woman; later revealed ripping open the rift and aligned closely with Thordak; Cerkonos reported this (Marisha, turns 821–841).
Party confirms Raishan likely responsible for Pyrah/Emon attack; team debating investigating her other disguises/locations (Sam/Marisha/Laura/Taliesin, turns 832–856).

Next possible destinations considered: retrieve Titanstone Knuckles from Kevdak/tribe (Whitestone/Grog's homeland) and consult a sphinx (library also suggested) (Marisha/Travis/Sam/Laura/Taliesin, turns 881–892).

Party's next destination decided: head toward Westruun to find Grog's herd (possible detour to Frostweald/sphinx/library); Grog's herd wanders Silvercut Roadway west of Westruun, south of Kraghammer, east of Emon (Sam/Travis/Laura/Taliesin/Matt, turns 912–921, 897–920).
Party plans to retrieve Titanstone Knuckles from Grog's herd; Grog estimates herd size ~6 (Travis/Marisha/Liam, turns 895–971).

Discussion about avoiding immediate recognition by Grog's herd: suggestion to use Hat of Disguise or shapeshifting (Taliesin suggested hat; Marisha can Wild Shape; party considered Trinket/wolf tracking) (Taliesin/Sam/Marisha/Travis, turns 940–958).

Party's next destination decided: head toward Westruun to find Grog's herd; Grog's herd wanders Silvercut Roadway west of Westruun, south of Kraghammer, east of Emon (Sam/Travis/Laura/Taliesin/Matt, turns 912–921, 897–920). Also considering Frostweald/sphinx first; party agreed 'sphinx first' (Sam/Travis, turns 1015–1017, 1033).

Discussion about avoiding immediate recognition by Grog's herd: suggestions include Hat of Disguise or Wild Shape; plan to use Vex's broom for travel; Marisha can scry for tree locations (Taliesin/Taliesin/Marisha/Sam, turns 1044–1048, 1046).

Marisha failed an Intelligence check (9) and can't recall specific Frostweald tree locations; DM noted trees near Crossroads (middle of Silvercut Roadway NW of Westruun) and Bramblewood Forest north of Westruun as closest options (Matt/Marisha, turns 1037–1050).
Party chose Bramblewood Forest (via petrified tree doorway) over Crossroads; they entered and are on central pathway; travel to Frostweald from here ~1–2 days (Matt/Marisha/Laura, turns 1061–1085).

Keyleth cast Wind Walk; party transformed into mist form and flew over treetops toward Westruun, spotting a 15–20 ft grassless dirt mound with spikes/grooves and two people removing a cart (Matt/Marisha, turns 1113–1115).
Marisha initially scryed trees; found a connection at Bramblewood entrance after difficulty; earlier note about failed Intelligence check remains relevant (Matt/Marisha, turns 1076–1081, 1038).
Observation of offerings site: large sweeping claw marks and scattered gold/silver coins; two humanoids hauling a cart were nearby (Perception/Investigation: Taliesin 18, Laura 16).
Westruun outskirts: some farms intentionally burned; armed guards watching farm workers; thin battlement/wall around city entrances observed (Perception: Vex/Vax noticed, turns 1132–1141).

Party transformed via Wind Walk, then reverted to physical form and stealth-approached hidden cornfield to investigate; Pass Without a Trace cast (Laura), stealth checks high (multiple natural/results listed).
Party chose Bramblewood Forest (via petrified tree doorway) over Crossroads; they entered and are on central pathway; travel to Frostweald from here ~1–2 days (Matt/Marisha/Laura, turns 1061–1085).

While in fields near Westruun, party observed abused farmers supplying food to city; one farmer Reginald (late 40s/50s, gray beard) revealed guards working for a dragon have taken people including his daughter; dragon seen ~every couple days, last at dusk yesterday (Matt/Laura/Taliesin, turns 1197–1271).
Farmer indicated captors include half-orcs; prisoners sometimes slaughtered as warnings; one likely holding area on outskirts of the farm district pointed toward the city (Matt, turns 1253–1262).
